race.comment: COLT FORTY FIVE (4) won two starts back at Donald then finished second last time out over 1200m at Echuca. Major player. SWITCH HIT (6) last appeared 11 weeks ago when he finished 3.5 lengths from the winner in seventh over 1400m at Werribee. Can feature off the short let-up. IMMORTAL TRIUMPH (8) finished midfield last start at Pakenham Synthetic over 1000m, 3.5 lengths from the winner. Tackles a longer journey this time and worth including. THE OPPORTUNIST (12) battled last start to finish fifth over 1200m at Ballarat Synthetic. Better than recent runs suggest and look for an improved run here.
